g.text: This book's calculation (figures/scripts/ch16_experiments.py; exact binomial; data/ch16_small_samples.csv): both versions truly give a "yes" 50% of the time,

text.style: fill: #1d1d1f; font: 9.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: equal runs per version. Chance threshold = the smallest gap, in either direction, that chance alone reaches less than 1 time in 20. A calculation, not data about any tool.
